a pooled RR of 1.40 (95% CI: 1.32 to 1.48) for CHD/CVD events comparing participants with low versus high cardiorespiratory
ﬁtness (Kodama et al., 2009). Several studies have also demonstrated that cardiorespiratory ﬁtness is associated with a lower
